notes.title: SuperTux released free on Steam, an open source classic
notes.content:
Giving a nice boost to a classic free and open source game, SuperTux has now been released on Steam and it's free to download and play.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2022/01/supertux-released-free-on-steam-an-open-source-classic

notes.title: Classic open source platformer SuperTux is coming to Steam
notes.content:
One we don't cover or hear about too often is SuperTux, a free and open source platformer that's been around for some time now and it's getting a Steam release.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2022/01/classic-open-source-platformer-supertux-is-coming-to-steam
